text:
maya: Heads-up — Thurs 1pm PT -> GateFlow + LangChain sandbox interoperability dry-run. Can we lock agenda and presenters? Need to validate connector auth flow, streaming, and error fallbacks. Also confirm which model variants we'll route to in the demo.
liam: I can present the Gateway adapter steps. Will cover auth + retry semantics and the adapter config.
sofia: I'll run the orchestration demo (canary + automatic fallback). Need the sample dataset (500 docs) — who's providing that?
andre: GateFlow said they'll provide the dataset and a preseeded Redis for KV cache. @maya can you confirm access details? Also we need a quick failover script to simulate node loss.
olivia: :thumbsup: I'll own partner comms and the joint announcement blurb. Quick Q: is there an embargo? GateFlow asked for a soft embargo until after our internal run.
integrations-bot: Reminder: runbook created at https://redwood.internal/integ/runbooks/gateflow-lc-rehearsal — please attach logs to this thread after tests.
maya: No public embargo, just an internal preview. GateFlow wants to sign off on the demo script before the partner-facing rehearsal. I'll DM Legal for a one-paragraph approval.
liam: For streaming, we'll use the Gateway 'stream_to' param and our SDK example: ```python
client.generate(..., stream=True)
``` We'll demonstrate fallback to a smaller quantized model when the high-perf node is unavailable.
sofia: Also need to validate metrics export (Prometheus + tracing). Demo should show routing decisions in traces so partners see automatic fallback.
andre: I'll add a small script to emit spans and a simple load generator. Example to run in sandbox: ```bash
./scripts/run_demo.sh --env sandbox --trace --load 50
```
maya: Who will flip the canary during the live demo? Need someone to switch traffic to fallback mid-demo.
liam: I can flip via the console (canary -> 50% -> 0). I'll also record a short clip as a backup in case connectivity is flaky.
olivia: For the marketplace listing, we need SKU mapping and exact model variant names. Partner will require SKU id for billing docs — can we produce that before Fri?
sofia: I'll pull SKU mapping from the marketplace registry and paste here once verified.
andre: GateFlow asked for latency SLOs to include in their docs. We'll provide p50/p95 numbers for the demo model variant and a note about queuing behavior under bursting.
maya: Action items: liam — adapter demo + fallback script; sofia — orchestration + metrics + SKU lookup; andre — traces + failover script; olivia — partner comms + embargo/legal check; me — confirm dataset + access and coordinate invites. Anything else?
liam: :thumbsup: Pushing a branch to repo 'integrations/gateflow-lc' and will ping here when it's ready.
integrations-bot: Deploy bot: staging deploy scheduled for 2025-04-10 19:00 UTC. Link: https://ci.redwood/deploys/7890
sofia: Can we do a full dry-run on Wed 4pm PT? Prefer a day-before smoke test. 🙏
olivia: Wed 4pm PT works for me.
andre: Works for me too.
maya: Perfect — I'll book calendar invites and attach the runbook + demo script. Thanks everyone :rocket:
liam: PS — need sample creds for the GateFlow sandbox. Partner contact is Julia at GateFlow (she sent a token via secure email).
maya: I'll forward the creds to the shared secrets store and ping when available.
sofia: Adding a quick checklist in the runbook: 1) dataset seeded, 2) creds in secrets, 3) traces enabled, 4) canary toggle verified, 5) recording backup.
andre: I'll stub the failure injection step and the script to make the demo deterministic.
olivia: I'll draft the 2-sentence partner blurb and share by EOD Friday for review.
maya: Great — see you at the dry-run.
